2024 Installation

BORDERS OF NEUTRALITY

BORDERS OF NEUTRALITY is a multimedia installation that reads the Alps as a shifting border archive, where melting glaciers redraw the lines of Swiss neutrality. A staged view from a mountain bench fractures under sonic disruptions and visual glitches. The project traces how geological aesthetics are co-opted into policy as visual tools of authority.

With: Aleksandra Nazarova
